text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} brought Emilia with him to the beach in the morning for a certain errand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}はエミリアを連れ、
とある用事のために朝の海岸へとやってきた。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Wow, what a breezy wind we have this morning. Even here at the summery beach, it's still cool and windy around...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
風がひんやりしてる。
夏の海でも、
朝の間なら
こんなに涼しいのね……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: There's no one around but us and it's so quiet, it feels like a completely different place from how it is in the daytime. I think I like this kind of beach too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰もいなくて静かだし、
昼間の海とは別物みたい。
こんな海もいいわね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...So you have some business in the forest today. Perhaps due to a request of help from someone?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……今日は
この森に用があるのよね。
もしかして、
ここに
困ってる人がいるのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Or maybe you're looking for ingredients for the Gourmets... or maybe, maybe is it because of that "partu-taimu" delivery job of yours?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それとも、
お届け物の
『あるばいと』とか、
もしかして
【美食殿】の活動で
食材を探しに……？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...It's something entirely different, you say? Then why are we in the forest so early in the morning...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
どれも違うの？
それじゃあ
どうして、
こんな朝早くから森に……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...Monsters! And lots of them at that......! I didn't expect this forest to be so dangerous!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──
魔物ね！　
それもたくさん……！
この森って、
こんなに危ない場所だったのね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Yes, it would be dangerous if someone came for a walk in a monster-infested forest!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうね。
誰かが森にお散歩に来ちゃったら危ないもの！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Looks like we got rid of them all. But there weren't any monsters here before, right? Maybe a flock of them came from somewhere...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでみんな追い払えたみたい。
でも、
前はここに魔物はいなかったはずよね？
群れが
どこかからやって来ちゃったのかしら……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Oh, perhaps your errand today was a request to defeat the monsters in this forest?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
もしかして
今日の用事って、
この森の魔物の
討伐依頼だったの？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: If you say that's only half right, then there's another half reason I'm missing. Hmm... Umm... I don't think I can guess it, it's sort of confusing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
半分ってことは、
あと半分
別の理由があるのね。
うーんと……
ええと……
全然分からない、
チンプンカンプンだわ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Having defeated the monsters, the two of them went further into the forest and stopped in front of a tree.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物を倒した二人はさらに森の奥へ進み、
一本の樹の前で歩みを止めた。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: So this is our destination? There seems to be just a big tree...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここが目的地なの？
大きな樹があるだけだけど……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Hmm... now that I look closely, there seems to be a black mass on the trunk! It's rustling and moving, and it has impressive horns... Is this... a bug?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……
よく見たら
黒いものがいっぱい付いてるわ！
カサカサ動いてて、
立派な角があって……
これは……
虫？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Ah, it flew away! Wait just a minute... Be a good girl and just let us catch you...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
飛んじゃった！
ちょっと待って……
いい子だから大人しく捕まって……！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} and Emilia successfully caught the beetle and returned to the beach. Then a young boy and girl came to them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無事にカブトムシを捕まえ、
海岸に戻ってきた{0}たち。
そんな二人のもとに幼い少年と少女がやってきた。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah, Onii-san! How was it? Were there any monsters?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
お兄さん！
どうだった？　
魔物いた？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness. Now we can all catch rhinoceros beetles together again without worry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかった。
これでまたみんなでカブトムシを採れますね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: So you were his clients this whole time? To hunt those monsters and rescue that beetle?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
あなたたちが
今回の依頼人？
魔物退治と
カブトムシの？

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: That's right! We're catching beetles to write about them in an observation diary!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだよー！
カブトムシ捕まえて、
観察日記を書くんだ！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: That forest was a great spot for collecting rhinoceros beetles, but recently monsters have taken up residence there, and it's been causing problems.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの森は絶好のカブトムシ採集スポットだったんですが、
最近になって
魔物が棲みついて
困っていたんです。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Since it was impossible for us to go there by ourselves, we asked and relied on Onii-san here. Did you catch something interesting?
text_block_list.orig_text:
僕らだけで採集に行くのは無理ってことで、
お兄さんにお願いしました。
成果はどうでしたか？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これは……！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Everything's okay now. All the monsters are gone, and we also managed to catch a beetle for you. Is this what you all wanted?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう大丈夫。
魔物はみんないなくなったし、
カブトムシもちゃんと捕まえてきたもの。
あなたたちが欲しかったのって、
これであってるかしら？

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Isn't that an Astraea giant beetle?! And what's more, this one has the deep color of a mountain rose and the luster of a stag beetle, making it a truly rare and mysterious beetle type!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アストライアオオツノコガネカブトじゃないですか！
しかもヤマブキ系の深みある色に
タマハガネの艶を備えた個体なんて、
まさに
まぼろしの激レアカブトムシです！！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: And that's not all! It's really big! Having a big size is fairly common for an Astraea giant stag beetle, but it's rare for a giant horned stag beetle to grow this big!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それだけじゃないよ！　
すごく大きい！
アストライアゴホンヅノダイオウカブトなら
わりと見るサイズだけど、
オオツノコガネカブトが
こんなに大きく育つのって
珍しいよね！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...Uh, I'm sorry, but on my part, I have no idea what you're talking about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ごめんなさい、
ちょっと何言ってるのか分かんない。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Wow, thank you so much! If I were to write an observation diary about such a rare beetle, I might even get a Landosol Minister's Award for bug observation...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わあぁぁ、
ありがとうございます！
こんな激レアカブトムシで観察日記を書いたら、
ランドソル大臣賞をもらえちゃうかもしれない……！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Then... what about this one? Is this one also a rare beetle?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ
こっちの子も？
珍しいカブトムシだったりする？

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: That's just a normal beetle you can find anywhere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは、
どこにでもいる
普通のカブトムシだねー

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I see... But even if it's not a rare kind, she's still cute, so I don't mind. There, there. Good girl, good girl.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなんだ……
でも、
珍しくなくても
可愛いから大丈夫ね。
よしよし。
いい子いい子。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Understood! Let's both do our best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かりました！
お互いに頑張りましょうね！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Those kids were just casually talking about it, but what's an observation diary?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子たちも言ってたけど、
観察日記って？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: So you raise and keep a beetle, observe its ecology, and write an observation diary about it...? You say its a staple of "Summah Vaca-shun"? It seems summer is filled with things to do!
text_block_list.orig_text:
カブトムシを飼って、
生態を観察して、
日記を書く……？
夏のお休みの定番？
夏って、
やることがすごーくたくさんあるのね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Now I understand! Since we're both here, I'll give it a try, too. Please tell me and show me other things I can do in this summer!
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かったわ！
せっかくだし、
私もやってみる。
他にも
夏にやることを、
色々と教えてね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One morning, {0} and Emilia arrived in front of the Gourmet Guild House.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とある日の朝。
{0}とエミリアは、
【美食殿】のギルドハウス前にやってきていた。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Good morning, {0}. I wonder, what are we going to do today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おはよう。
今日は何をするのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: What a cute flower♪ I wonder if I'll be able to draw it well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
可愛いお花ね♪
上手く描けるかしら。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...Umm, what's with that pot over there? It's got wavy ivy growing in it, and it doesn't look like the morning glory we're going to draw.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ええと、
そっちにある鉢は何？
ツタがうねうねしてて、
こっちの
アサガオとは似てないけど。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: A carnivorous plant...!? A species that eats insects? What a scary flower...
text_block_list.orig_text:
食虫植物……！？
植物が虫を食べちゃうの？　
こわい花なのね……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Heyas you two☆! What are you up to together so early in the morning?
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人ともオイッス～☆
こんなに朝早くから
何をやってるんですか？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Pecorine. Right now, we're drawing pictures of a morning glory.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おはよう、
ペコリーヌ。
今はね、
アサガオの絵を描いているの。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I see... What wonderful pictures. The colors are especially beautiful☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど～……
素敵な絵ですねっ。
特に、
色合いがとってもきれいです☆

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you could tell? Actually, this color is made from colored water {0} extracted from real morning glories earlier.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
わかる？
実はこの色、
さっき
本物のアサガオから作った色水を使ってるの。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I never would've imagined you could make paint like this. I bet even Lugnica's flowers could produce an amazing set of colors.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんな風にして絵の具を作れるなんて知らなかったわ。
これなら
ルグニカのお花でもできそうね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, Emilia was groaning at a desk in a corner of the library.
text_block_list.orig_text:
またある日。
エミリアたちは図書館の一角で、机に向かってうなっていた。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Hmm, this is tough...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
難しいわ……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're the girl with the fluffy cat... Emilia, wasn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
あなたは、
モフモフした猫の娘さん……
エミリアさんですよね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Kyouka-chan! Hello. Did you have business here too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
キョウカちゃん、
こんにちは。
あなたもここに用事があったの？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Yes, Misogi and Mimi... I mean, my friends were having a hard time with their summer homework, so I was called to help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
ミソギたちが……
友だちが夏休みの宿題に苦戦していて、
助けに呼ばれたんです。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: It seems like they can manage most of their summer homework, but the two of them said writing a book report was too hard. If they read more books it wouldn't be as difficult, I say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
他の宿題はなんとかなりそうだけど、
読書感想文が書けないって。
普段から本を読んでいれば、
そんなに難しくないのに。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: What perfect timing! Actually, I'm also writing a book report too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょうどよかったわ！
実は私も、
その
読書感想文っていうのを書いているの。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: However I don't think I'm that good of a writer... {0} told me to just honestly put into words what I feel, but when I try, it ends up being really difficult.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
あんまりうまく書けなくて……
感じたことを素直に言葉にするんだよ、
って
言われたんだけど、
やってみるとすごーく難しいのね。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Emilia-san, so you're writing an essay too? Is it for school homework or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
エミリアさんも感想文を？
学校の宿題とかですか？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: No, I'm writing this so I can investigate the activities done during summer. {0} told me that one part of his "Summah Vaca-shun" is also writing book reports like those.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん。
私は夏にやることをお勉強するために書いてるの。
夏休みと言えば読書感想文、
って聞いたんだけど。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: I don't really get that, but it's very admirable that you're willing to do it on your own. In that case, I'll lend you my help. I want to support those who work hard.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よくわかりませんけど、
自主的に取り組むのはとても立派ですね。
それなら私も、
力を貸してあげますよ。
がんばる人のことは応援してあげたいですし。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Kyouka-chan! Kyoka-chan, you're so amazing, even though you're just a child, you act so mature. I can see why {0} called you a Mama.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
キョウカちゃん！
キョウカちゃんって、
子どもなのに大人っぽくてすごいわ。
ママって呼ばれてたのも納得ね。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: You don't have to accept that!
text_block_list.orig_text: それは納得しなくていいです！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, Emilia and her friends were at the Nagashi Somen Festival held in the city of Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
またある日。
ランドソル市街で催された流しそうめん祭りの会場に、
エミリアたちの姿があった。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Scooping up the noodles as they flow by and eating them... Those do feel like bad manners to me, but I suppose {0} said this is also a summery tradition?
text_block_list.orig_text:
流れてくる麺をすくって食べる……
すこーしお行儀が悪い気がするけど、
これも夏の定番なの？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Certainly, if someone who doesn't know about it heard about it, they'd think it was a joke. However true enough, this is also a summery tradition.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに
知らない人が見たら、
冗談だと思うでしょうね。
でもこれも、
れっきとした夏の文化なのよ。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: But be careful. This Nagashi Somen event is sponsored by the Mercurius Foundation, so things might not go as smooth as you might think as per their tradition.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただ、気を付けて。
今回の流しそうめんは
【メルクリウス財団】の主催だから、
一筋縄ではいかないかもしれないわ。

text_block_list.name: Contestant 1
text_block_list.text: WHAT THE HELL'S THIS?! This isn't just flowing water, it's a raging torrent!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだこりゃあ！
ただの流れ水じゃねぇ、
まさに激流だ！！

text_block_list.name: Contestant 2
text_block_list.text: Damn it, my chopsticks were taken away!! If I were to put my hands in this current instead, I'll end up getting swept away instead of the somen!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちくしょう、
箸が持ってかれた！！
下手に手を出したら、
そうめんじゃなくて
俺たちが流されちまう！！

text_block_list.name: Contestant 3
text_block_list.text: A curveball, aim for the curveball!! Even just one is fine, scoop it up while the current slows down even a little!
text_block_list.orig_text:
カーブだ、
カーブを狙え！！
一本でもいい、
少しでも減速した隙にすくい取るんだ！

text_block_list.name: Contestant 4
text_block_list.text: It's no good, it's not slowing down even if we aim for a curveball!! Do these noodles value their lives or something?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメだ、
カーブでも全く速度が緩まねぇ！！
このそうめん共、
命が惜しくねぇのかぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I knew something like this would happen... I’m sorry, Emilia, but maybe you should give up on eating somen noodles...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりこうなるのね……
ごめんなさいエミリア、
そうめんを食べるのは
諦めた方がいいかも……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: No, I'll still give it a try! I just have to scoop up that "somen" and eat it, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
やってみるわ！
あのそうめんをすくって食べればいいんでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Merely by watching the flow of the water carefully... There!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
水の流れをよく見て……
えいっ！！

text_block_list.name: Contestant 1
text_block_list.text: WHAAAAAAAT?! Eating somen noodles despite those rapids... who is that girl!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにぃっ！？
この激流の中でそうめんを……
あの嬢ちゃん、
何者だ！？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Yay! It's so smooth... Mm, delicious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった！　
つるつる……
ん、
おいしい！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Another day, Emilia and her friends came to watch the beach baseball tournament held on the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
またある日。
エミリアたちは海岸で開かれたビーチベースボール大会の
観戦にやってきた。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: The strongest team that will stand at the top of the baseball world on the continent of Astraia... That will be decided here today. The final showdown of youth. ...Just kidding. I am working as a manager at my academy's baseball club, tough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アストライア大陸の球界で頂点に立つ、
最強のチーム……
それが今日
ここで決まるのよ。
青春の総決算、
頂上決戦よ。
なーんて。
あたしは野球部のマネージャーを
ちょっとやっただけだけど。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I was taught by {0} back in town that if I wanted to enjoy my summer youth, I should come here. Is this what they call "bee-achu bayse-baru"? I wonder what kind of game it is?
text_block_list.orig_text:
夏の青春を楽しむなら
ここに来るように
って街の人に教わったんだけど。
『びーちべーすぼーる』って言うの？
どういう遊びなのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: To put it simply, it's a sport where you hit a ball thrown at a stadium on the beach. I know it sounds a little ridiculous, but I swear I'm not lying, okay?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
簡単に説明すると、
浜辺のスタジアムで投げられたボールを打つ、
っていうスポーツよ。
端折りすぎてるけど、
まあ嘘じゃないわよ？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I wonder if this is something Subaru would understand better... I personally don’t really get it, but it might be still interesting to try.
text_block_list.orig_text:
スバルなら
分かるのかしら……
よく分からないけど、
やってみたら面白いのかも。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I know right! There's an experience corner over there, so let's take a look! Seeing is believing, as they say!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！
向こうに体験コーナーがあるから、
ちょっと覗いてみましょ！
百聞は一見に如かず、
ってね！

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: Hello, come on in. At this special batting center, you can experience hitting a professional fastball.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やぁいらっしゃい。
この特設バッティングセンターでは、
プロの剛速球が体験できるよ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry. Is there a way to experience a softer thrown ball? I wanted to teach the rules to this girl since its her first time doing this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
ごめんなさい。
もっと緩い球のところはない？
初めて観戦する子に、
ルールを教えてあげたくて。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Therefore using this, I have to hit the fast ball coming towards me, huh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで
飛んでくる球を打てばいいのね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't be reckless and just go in all of a sudden. A complete amateur would just get so surprised that they'd fall on their buts──Wait...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと、
いきなりはさすがに無謀でしょ。
ド素人じゃ、
びっくりして尻もちつくだけよ──
って……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: HIYAH!!
text_block_list.orig_text: やあっ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Organizer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's a home run! Even though it was a professional fastball, she caught it at the core perfectly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うおっ、
ホームランだ！
プロの速球だってのに、
完璧に芯を捉えてたよ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Wow, my hands are tingling... but it's so much fun! Could I try this again?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
手がジーンとする……
でも、
すごーく楽しい！
もう一回やってみてもいい？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Emilia, aren’t you interested in joining my academy's baseball club?! In fact, don't go back to your original world, come over and join Ama-ka Academy together with me, {0} and the others! Special scholarship treatment awaits you!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
エミリア、
あんた
野球部に興味ない！？
っていうか
元の世界に帰らないで、
ア魔学行きましょ！
特待生待遇が待ってるから！！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: K-Kyaru, calm down...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
ちょっと、キャルってば、
落ち着いて……！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Another evening, Emilia visited the guild house of the Gourmets.
text_block_list.orig_text:
またある日の夕方。
エミリアは【美食殿】のギルドハウスを訪れた。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Sorry to intrude!
text_block_list.orig_text: おじゃまします！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: {0}! I'm glad to find you here. I was out walking a while ago, and the man at the bakery saw me and asked me to deliver something. Here, for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いてくれてよかったわ。
さっきお散歩してたら、
パン屋のおじさんにお届け物を頼まれたの。
あなたに、
って。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: It seems like people in town are starting to recognize me. They just casually talk to me as I walk by.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか私も、
街の人に
顔を覚えてもらえてきたみたい。
話しかけてくれる人が
増えてきたの。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I think that's kind of amazing. It makes me feel like I've gotten embraced by people here in Landosol, like I'm part of the town.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こういうの、
なんだかすごーくいいなって。
私もランドソルに馴染めてきたんだって、
実感できるもの。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: So, what were you doing? Are those things you're handling painting tools?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
何をしてたのかしら？
それって、
もしかして
お絵描き道具？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Ah, the beetle observation diary I assume! Could I take a look?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
カブトムシの観察日記ね！
見てもいい？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Wow, there's so many different pictures... Wait, but they aren't merely about beetles...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ、
いろんな絵がある……
あれ、
でも
カブトムシのことだけじゃない……？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: An ice slide... catching beetles in the forest... writing a book report... Could this be...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
氷の滑り台……
森で
カブトムシ採り……
読書感想文……
これってもしかして……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I thought so! In this picture is Kyouka-chan, and in this one... Saren-san? And then there's Kokkoro-chan and Kyaru-san too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり！
こっちの絵は
キョウカちゃんで、
こっちは
サレンさん？
それから
コッコロちゃんに
キャルも……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: You've turned all of my summer memories here into actual pictures. I'm so happy...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
夏の思い出を、
全部絵にしてくれてるのね。
すごーくうれしい……！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I see, the rest is still blank... Of course, since this "Summah Vaca-shun" isn't over yet.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか、
続きはまだ白紙なんだ……
夏休みはまだ終わっていないんだから、
当然ね。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: In that case, let me draw together with you! Drawing this together will also become a new summer memory that way, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら、
私も一緒に描かせて！
これを描くのも、
同じように夏の思い出になるんでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Ok, since that's now decided, I'll do my best! Umm, what should I draw first...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
そうと決まれば
しゃかりき頑張るわ！
ええと、
まずは何を描こうかしら……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Her summer memories now have a tangible form, left upon a diary full of pictures. Emilia’s heart danced as she joined {0} in a circle of collaboration.
text_block_list.orig_text:
数々の夏の思い出を形にして残す。
その共同作業の輪に仲間入りし、エミリアは心を躍らせるのだった。
